cod_assessment.independent: 2027-Q4 (low confidence — no signed IA for this specific INR)
reasoning_evidence: 27INR0614 (Phase 2, 200.71 MW) has NO signed IA of its own — queue milestones (screeningStudyComplete, fisApproved, iaSigned, construction) are all null except FIS requested 2026-06-26; a queue entry at this stage is normally 18-36 months from IA execution, let alone COD

The sibling/co-located project at the identical POI ('Revolution Switch' 138kV, adjacent to Navarro Sub) — 21INR0421 'Armadillo Solar' Phase 1, same SPV shell Armadillo Solar Center LLC, same EPC Hanwha Q Cells — took from original IA (2021-02-02, COD then 2022-12-31) through 6 more amendments to its CURRENT schedule of COD 2026-12-31, a slip of exactly 4 years from its first contractual date. If Phase 2 follows a similar arc from FIS-requested (2026-06) to IA signature (unknown, likely 2026-Q4/2027 at earliest) to construction to COD, 2027-03-04 is not plausible as a hard date; it reads as an early placeholder in the queue rather than a grounded schedule

Positive reality signals: TCEQ construction-stormwater registration RN112015482 IS ACTIVE (permit TXR1538TO) with EPC Hanwha Q Cells on board since 2025-02-07, and Sentinel-2 imagery shows active grading/racking-stage construction at the shared site since ~2025-Q3/Q4 — but this activity is attributable to Phase 1 (whose IA schedule matches it almost exactly), not confirmed for Phase 2 specifically

Phase 1's own history of schedule slippage (2022-12-31 -> 2025-10-21-equivalent -> 2026-12-31 in successive amendments) plus the original abatement agreement's targeted 2024-12-31 COD (also missed) establishes a strong PATTERN of multi-year COD slip at this site/developer — applied to Phase 2's claimed 2027-03-04, a comparable slip pattern implies a REAL independent estimate is closer to late 2027 or 2028, contingent on when Phase 2's own IA is executed (not yet observed)
Not in EIA-860M (eia_history.py 27INR0614 --write) — expected for a pre-IA project, but confirms no independent third-party COD signal exists yet beyond the queue's own self-reported date
queue_history.py: only 1 snapshot on record (2026-06-01), 0 COD changes — the queue has not yet had a chance to show drift for this specific INR; this is a projection risk, not an observed-drift risk

contractual_schedule.note: ALL 4 IA filings found (via puct.py match --key 'Armadillo Solar Center') are captioned GINR 21INR0421 (Phase 1), never 27INR0614 (Phase 2, the target of this research). No IA has been located for 27INR0614 itself — consistent with queue data (iaSigned=null) and PLAYBOOK D1 'no IA on disk' path. POI for Phase 1: 'Revolution Switch at 138kV...adjacent to TSP's existing 69kV Navarro Sub on Main St in the town of Navarro' — matches target's POI text '3387 Revolution 138kV' (same substation/interconnection point), strongly suggesting Phase 2 is a real co-located expansion at the same POI, riding the same SPV shell (Armadillo Solar Center, LLC) and EPC (Hanwha Q Cells EPC USA LLC per TCEQ).
